context_title: a teljes kódot kijavítva vissza küldöd. minden egyes karaktert leírsz, nem rövidítesz. minden hibát kijavítasz. egy fájl marad. ne írj semmi mást csak a teljes kódot es kommentek nem lehetnek benne! soha semmi egyszerusitett mock placeholder dummy szimulalt fake szart nem engedelyezek es teljes fájl roviditetlen production ready kód

entries.query: a teljes kódot kijavítva vissza küldöd. minden egyes karaktert leírsz, nem rövidítesz. minden hibát kijavítasz. egy fájl marad. ne írj semmi mást csak a teljes kódot es kommentek nem lehetnek benne! soha semmi egyszerusitett mock placeholder dummy szimulalt fake szart nem engedelyezek es teljes fájl roviditetlen production ready kód
entries.answer:
```
Makefile
HASKELL = ghc
JULIA = julia
ZIG = zig
ODIN = odin
NIM = nim
CHPL = chpl
PONYC = ponyc
ELIXIR = elixir
UNISON = unison
AGDA = agda
TLA = tla2tools
DEDUKTI = dedukti
ISABELLE = isabelle
IMANDRA = imandra
CLASH = clash
FORTH = gforth
ATS = patscc
ASTRAL = astral
DEX = dex
HALIDE = halide
TERRA = terra
RACKET = racket
FACTOR = factor
AREND = arend
VERUS = verus
TAICHI = taichi
SOUFFLE = souffle
WHILEY = whileyc
GLEAM = gleam
COQ = coqc
F = gfortran
LIQUID = liquid
TEYJUS = teyjus
FUTHARK = futhark
BALSA = balsa-c
V = v
SWIPL = swipl
CRYSTAL = crystal
ROC = roc
LLC = llc
COQIDE = coqide
LEAN = lean
SPINALHDL = spinalhdl
VALE = vale
VERILOG = iverilog
RUSTC = cargo build --release
SOLIDITY = hardhat compile
REACT_NATIVE = expo build

all: build
build:
	$(ZIG) build-exe sel4/anomaly_detector.zig -target x86_64-linux -dynamic -O ReleaseSafe --name sel4_mod -lrdkafka
	$(HASKELL) -dynamic -o clash_mod clash/accelerator.hs
	$(DEDUKTI) -p lf dedukti/verification.dk > dedukti_proof.txt
	$(PONYC) -r pony/ueba.pony -o pony_mod
	$(RACKET) bloom/anomaly.rkt > anomaly_output.txt
	$(TLA) -config TLCConfig.tla stratego/log_analysis.tla
	$(FUTHARK) opencl futhark/correlation.fut -o corr_mod
	$(TEYJUS) teyjus/threat.lp && tjlink threat -o threat_mod
	$(ODIN) build geometric/spatial.odin -out:geo_mod
	$(UNISON) run unison/intel.u
	$(CHPL) chapel/bigcorr.chpl -o big_mod
	$(HASKELL) -dynamic -o chp_mod chp/detection.chp
	$(BALSA) balsa/accelerator.balsa -o balsa_mod
	$(LLC) llvmir/opt.ll -o opt.o && $(ZIG) build-exe opt.o -dynamic -O ReleaseSafe -o llvm_mod
	$(CRYSTAL) build crystal/monitor.cr -o crystal_mod --release
	$(ROC) build roc/pipeline.roc -o roc_mod
	$(NIM) c --opt:speed -d:release -o:nim_mod nim/tool.nim
	$(ZIG) build-exe zig/detector.zig -target x86_64-linux -dynamic -O ReleaseSafe --name zig_mod -lrdkafka
	elixir -o ueba.beam ueba.exs
	$(FACTOR) -run=rules rules.factor > factor_output.txt
	$(V) -shared -o v_mod vlang/scanner.v
	$(SWIPL) -s prolog/rules.pl -g "consult('input.json'), detect_threats, halt."
	$(ODIN) build odin/crit.odin -out:crit_mod
	$(ZIG) build-exe main.zig -target x86_64-linux -dynamic -O ReleaseSafe --name main -lrdkafka
	$(JULIA) --project=. julia/intelligence.jl
	$(DEX) dex/ml.dex -o dex_ml
	$(HALIDE) -o halide_image image halide/image.halide -e ocl
	terra terra/kernel.terra -o terra_kernel
	$(RACKET) racket/logic.rkt
	$(FORTH) --die-on-signal forth/hardware.forth
	$(ATS) -o ats_system ats/system.ats
	$(ASTRAL) astral/core.astral -o astral_core
	$(AREND) arend/meta.arend -o arend_meta
	$(VERUS) compile verus/rust.verus --extern-crate verus_lib
	taichi taichi/sim.taichi --output taichi_sim
	$(SOUFFLE) -o souffle_mod souffle/datalog.dl
	$(WHILEY) whiley/safe.whiley -o whiley_safe
	gleam build gleam/parallel.gleam --target javascript
	$(COQ) -o coq_gallina.vo coq/gallina.v
	$(F) -o f_quantum f/quantum.f -std=f2008
	$(LIQUID) --with-ghc -o liquid_haskell LiquidHaskell.hs
	agda cubical-agda/meta.agda -i -o cubical_meta
	$(TLA) tla/pluscal.tla
	$(COQIDE) coq/gallina.vo
	$(LEAN) lean/config.lean -o lean_config
	$(ISABELLE) -b isabelle/consensus.thy
	$(IMANDRA) --codegen -o imandra_crypto imandra/crypto.imandra
	spinalhdl --genVerilog spinal/hardware.spinal -o spinal_hardware.v
	vale vale/lowlevel.vale -o vale_lowlevel
	$(VERILOG) -o verilog_circuit verilog/circuit.v
	$(RUSTC) rust_mod
	$(SOLIDITY) solidity_mod
	$(REACT_NATIVE) react_native_mod
run:
	./main
clean:
	rm -f sel4_mod clash_mod pony_mod corr_mod threat_mod geo_mod big_mod chp_mod balsa_mod llvm_mod crystal_mod roc_mod nim_mod zig_mod v_mod crit_mod julia_intelligence dex_ml halide_image terra_kernel racket_logic forth_hardware ats_system astral_core arend_meta verus_rust taichi_sim souffle_mod whiley_safe gleam_parallel coq_gallina f_quantum liquid_haskell cubical_meta tla_pluscal lean_config isabelle_consensus imandra_crypto spinal_hardware vale_lowlevel verilog_circuit *.o *.beam *.txt *.vo *.thy *.lean *.agda *.tla *.imandra *.v *.whiley *.gleam *.taichi *.souffle *.out *.f *.hs *.v *.spinal *.vale dedukti_proof.txt anomaly_output.txt factor_output.txt target/release/rust_mod contracts/build artifacts cache
```
